# Enrique Bruzual - Principal AI Solutions Architect

30+ years of software leadership, specializing in Python, AI Orchestration, and Human-Centric System Design.

## Core Technical Profile

- **Expertise:** Production-grade Python, AI Implementation, AI SaaS Architecture, Multi-Agent Orchestration.
- **Background:** Degree in Communications (Concentration in Graphic Design & New Media).
- **The Edge:** 30+ years of engineering discipline merged with high-level design thinking. I bridge the gap between "back-end power" and "front-end clarity."
- **Specialization:** Building resilient AI systems that bridge the gap between "experimental" and "production-ready" (Modern Legacy).research.
- **Key Projects:** KillShot (85.3% noise rejection pipeline), voice.Zerikai (MCP + Django multi-tenant SaaS).

### Post-Mortem: Building a Local MCP Server for Codebase Memory using Ollama and ChromaDB
- **URL:** https://enriquebruzual.github.io/blog/Post-Mortem_Building_Local_MCP_Server_Codebase_Memory_using_Ollama_and_ChromaDB.html
- **Summary:** A deep dive into building a local MCP server for codebase memory using Ollama and ChromaDB. We explore local RAG, VRAM optimization for quantized models, and routing strategies for an agentic IDE workspace within hardware bounds.

### Your IDE is bleeding money and context. Here's how to stop it
- **URL:** https://enriquebruzual.github.io/blog/reduce-ai-ide-token-costs-with-zerikai-memory.html
- **Summary:** As AI coding tools shift to token-based billing, inefficient context retrieval is driving up costs. Zerikai Memory is an open-source, local MCP server that uses deterministic parsing to provide targeted, cost-effective context for any IDE.

### How to Build a Free ElevenLabs Post-Call Webhook in Python
- **URL:** https://enriquebruzual.github.io/blog/Build_a_Free_ElevenLabs_Post-Call_Webhook_in_Python.html
- **Summary:** This tutorial guides you through building a production-ready Python Flask application that acts as a secure webhook to receive real-time post-call data from an ElevenLabs AI voice agent. It covers essential steps such as verifying HMAC signatures for secure authentication, persisting call metrics and transcripts into a local SQLite database, and configuring automated email alerts via Gmail's SMTP server. Finally, it provides comprehensive instructions on how to set up and deploy the completed application to PythonAnywhere, ensuring your robust notification system runs continuously on the internet.

### Build a WhatsApp Bot with Sentiment Analysis using Python and Twilio
- **URL:** https://enriquebruzual.github.io/blog/twilio_whatsapp.html

It guides readers through the entire process, from setting up the Python environment and training a custom classifier to configuring ngrok and connecting the application to the Twilio WhatsApp Sandbox for real-time emotional monitoring (part of Twilio’s archive)
